newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Savoy offers to buy 30.81 pct of New Star.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Savoy offers to buy 30.81 pct of New Star.

text.p: South Korea's Savoy Hotel said on Wednesday it would re-offer to buy an additional 30.81 percent stake in New Star Trading Co at 65,500 won per share.
The Seoul-based hotel offered to buy 148,592 common shares of the garment maker after receiving tenders, which will open on June 30 and close on July 19 through Ssangyong Securities.
New Star's share price closed at 60,200 won on Wednesday.

If completed, Savoy with its affiliate and owner family members would be the largest shareholder with a 51.51 percent stake in New Star. Savoy had earlier said it wanted to take over New Star to diversify its business.
Savoy told the Korea Stock Exchange in April it would buy 25.3 percent of New Star Trading, which would have been the country's first hostile takeover.
But the Securities Supervisory Board warned Savoy about illegal trading.
The watchdog accused Savoy hotel and its affiliate of secretly buying shares of New Star trading and ordered Savoy to reduce its holding in New Star to 22.67 percent.
Savoy reduced its stake in New Star to 20.70 percent before announcing its re-offer.
